fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

When the next Magic set had not been officially announced, the home page displayed a season end date derived from an estimated rotation (code `'???'`) as if it were a firm date. This could mislead users into thinking the rotation date was confirmed.

## What changed

- `decksite/views/home.py` (`setup_rotation`): Added `self.season_end_is_estimated = seasons.next_rotation_ex().code == '???'` to expose the estimation flag to the template.
- `decksite/templates/home.mustache`: Changed the season end sentence to use Mustache conditional blocks — rendering "ends (expected) {{season_end_display}}" when the flag is truthy, and the original "ends {{season_end_display}}" otherwise.

The PD 500 date is already handled elsewhere: `tournaments.pd500_date()` returns epoch (1970) when the next set is unannounced, so `pd500_date` is never set on the view and the PD 500 sentence is not rendered at all when the rotation is unknown.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed)
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit magic` — 845 passed, 1 skipped in 19.72s

Fixes #11594
